purpose: Bounded evidence artifact that directly releases null relation geometry without inventing survey truth.

acquisition_window.reason: bounded ±0.01 degree window around the only coordinate-bearing authority; not a survey extent

adapter_target.endpoint_class: Overpass API or equivalent OSM data export

patch_targets.accept_if: candidate waterway has explicit OSM way/relation identity and geometry inside acquisition window; relation-to-village interpretation remains separate
patch_targets.patch: geometry + source_id + osm_type + osm_id + version + timestamp + retrieved_at

patch_targets.accept_if: route hierarchy can be justified from OSM tags or remains UNKNOWN; geometry alone must not assert primary status
patch_targets.patch: geometry + provenance; preserve hierarchy claim as relation-only unless justified

patch_targets.accept_if: building footprints can be captured as individual source features; do not dissolve into a heritage boundary
patch_targets.patch: source-bound building members or keep null

release_condition: At least one stable relation receives traceable source geometry with per-feature provenance and passes CRS84/source-alignment/topology readback. Unmatched relations remain geometry:null.
next_allowed_action: Execute the bounded OSM acquisition query, preserve raw returned identities, then patch only matched stable relations in C01-WORLD-REMOTE-RELATION_v0.1.geojson and remote-readback the result.
